mapper.sql: SELECT r.*, d.name AS dept_name, u.nickname AS create_by_name, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scm_requisition_item i WHERE i.requisition_id = r.id) AS item_count FROM scm_requisition r LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.id = r.dept_id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = r.create_by
mapper.select: SELECT i.*, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, s.name AS supplier_name, o.order_no FROM scm_requisition_item i JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = i.material_id LEFT JOIN scm_supplier s ON s.id = i.supplier_id LEFT JOIN scm_order o ON o.id = i.order_id WHERE i.requisition_id = #{requisitionId} ORDER BY i.id
